meta.name: pathfinder
meta.description: Map a codebase into feature-grouped flowcharts, identify duplicated concerns across features, and propose a unified architecture. Use when asked to "find the ideal path," unify duplicated systems, or audit architecture before a refactor. Emits a proposed unified flowchart plus per-system /make-plan prompts.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将代码库映射为功能流程图，识别重复并统一架构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在重构或统一多个重复系统
copy.tagline_en: Map codebase into feature flowcharts, identify duplicates, and unify architecture
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are refactoring or unifying duplicated systems

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会把代码库梳理成按功能分组的 Mermaid 流程图,找出跨功能的重复逻辑,提出最简统一架构,并生成可直接交给 /make-plan 的提示词。它只产出图表和方案,不写实现代码。
howto.when: 当你要求「找理想路径」、统一重复的系统,或想在重构前审查架构时触发。

say.text: 用 pathfinder 梳理这个代码库的功能流程图
say.note: 先出功能清单,再逐个功能画图

say.text: 找出各功能里重复的逻辑,给统一方案
say.note: 产出重复报告和统一流程图

say.text: 为统一后的系统生成 /make-plan 提示词

howto.what_en: Claude maps your codebase into feature-grouped Mermaid flowcharts, finds duplicated concerns across features, proposes a unified architecture, and emits /make-plan handoff prompts. It writes diagrams and plans, not implementation code.
howto.when_en: Use when you want to "find the ideal path," unify duplicated systems, or audit architecture before a refactor.

say_en.text: Use pathfinder to map this codebase into feature flowcharts
say_en.note: First a feature inventory, then one chart per feature

say_en.text: Find duplicated logic across features and propose a unified design
say_en.note: Outputs a duplication report and unified flowchart

say_en.text: Generate /make-plan prompts for the unified systems
